high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an article from the website wired.com, specifically discussing the "Whole Earth Catalog." The article includes a quote attributed to Stewart Brand: "Stay hungry, stay foolish." This quote is highlighted as being the uplifting kicker that Hawley had asked for, and it later became famous as the punchline for the most renowned college address ever. The text also mentions that Stewart Brand remarked on becoming famous late in life due to this quote winding up as part of the address. Below the text, there are two images of book covers from the "Whole Earth Catalog.
